ZHUBUNTU Guide

Welcome to use ZHUBUNTU!

Zhubuntu isn't the distribution of Ubuntu. It is just an open-source Android desktop environment, like GNOME's style. It is easy-to-use ,always for free, and safe. If you have any problems ,please send me an email =F0=9F=93=A7 to 972059313@qq.com.

Plenty of Internal Applications for You

There are plenty internal apps developed by us, such as calculator, browser, and novel reader. They're free , stylish , open-source and safe, no advertisement, no virus. You can also add your apps that have installed on your phone to ZHUBUNTU desktop.

Together ,Chase Our Poetry and Beyond

This project is developed by two junior high students ,Zreamer and Song130103 .If you have some good ideas ,send us an email to 972059313@qq.com. This project belongs to everyone, you can download the source code and edit it .Let us build ZHUBUNTU together.

Now ,Start to Install It

1. First, click here to download and install ZHUBUNTU app and Any Launcher (by Tumuyan)
2. Second, open Any Launcher, click =E9=80=89=E6=8B=A9=E5=BA=94=E7=94=A8=>=E4=BC=98=E5=85=88=E4=BB=8E=E5=90=8E=E5=8F=B0=E5=88=87=E6=8D=A2=E5=88=B0=E5=89=8D=E5=8F=B0=>Zhubuntu.
3. Third ,click =E8=AE=BE=E7=BD=AE=E6=A1=8C=E9=9D=A2 (if it quit by flashing, please go to System settings=>Application settings=Default Desktop app =>AnyLauncher)
4. Lastly, return to desktop, success!
